message.vanguard-spirits.ruin.hollowed: Something settles in the ground above you.
mural.vanguard-spirits.0.body:
We were not soldiers. We were the ones who stayed behind when the rest went on, to keep what could not be carried.

This ground is ours. Walk on it gently. Every name beneath your feet chose to be beneath your feet.
mural.vanguard-spirits.0.title: The Watch Set Down
mural.vanguard-spirits.1.body:
The stair goes down through our dead on purpose.

Anyone who wants what we kept must first cross the whole field of those who kept it. We thought that would be warning enough.

It was not, or you would not be standing here.
mural.vanguard-spirits.1.title: Why the Graves Lie Above
mural.vanguard-spirits.2.body:
A memory does not end. It breaks.

The pieces fall out of a person as they go and settle into whatever lies nearest, and deepslate holds them better than anything else we tried. Down here the walls are thick with other people's lives.

We learned to pick them up. That was the beginning of it.
mural.vanguard-spirits.2.title: What the Stone Keeps
mural.vanguard-spirits.3.body:
Sera could clear a ravine from standing. Toma walked further in a day than a horse. Ilen never once needed a torch.

We bound what was left of each of them into stone, and the stone gave it back. For a while it felt like keeping them.

There was a fourth. I will come to her.
mural.vanguard-spirits.3.title: The First Binding
mural.vanguard-spirits.4.body:
Take one fragment and the rest of a person settles. Take enough and there is nothing left to settle.

They still rise. They still know the shape of a stair and the shape of a stranger. They do not know us.

We made every one of them. Remember that when they come up out of the ground at you.
mural.vanguard-spirits.4.title: What We Took
mural.vanguard-spirits.5.body:
We stopped too late, and stopping was the whole of what we could do.

The work went down and the door went over it, and we laid our own dead across the lid -- not as a lock, but as a ledger.

Read the names on your way down. That is the price, written out.
mural.vanguard-spirits.5.title: The Sealing
mural.vanguard-spirits.6.body:
Vela was the fourth. She would not let us take a piece of her.

She gave the whole of it instead, standing, into the stone at the middle of this room, and asked one thing: that it never be allowed to gather.

So it guards and does not take. It will not tire and it will not want. It is the best of us, and it will not know you.
mural.vanguard-spirits.6.title: The One Who Stayed
mural.vanguard-spirits.7.body:
I am the last, and I am writing this badly, because my hands are old.

The birds came a week ago and have not gone. They know before we do. They will circle until the last of us is down, and then they will keep circling, because that is what they are for.

Take what you need from the reliquary. Leave the rest for whoever comes after. There is always someone after.
mural.vanguard-spirits.7.title: The Last Hand
screen.vanguard-spirits.epitaph.elsewher: There is no graveyard here, so nothing will settle and nothing will change. It will stand as a marker only. You cannot pick the stone back up.
screen.vanguard-spirits.epitaph.in_ruin: The graves here will go quiet for good — nothing will rise again, and there will be no more memories to take. You cannot pick the stone back up.
screen.vanguard-spirits.epitaph.settled: This ground is already quiet — a stone stands here and the graves are done rising. Another will change nothing. You cannot pick it back up.
screen.vanguard-spirits.epitaph.title: Set the Epitaph down?
